N1.subject: BagIt SHA requirements, hex file manifests, Oxum units, complete/valid semantics
N1.independent_outcome: Confirmed with RFC8493 §§2.2.2/2.4/3/5.4. Oxum is OctetCount.StreamCount and is only a precheck. Final fixes the draft discovery octets.bytes error.

N1.subject: bagit-python defaults, fast mode and rejection taxonomy
N1.independent_outcome: v1.9.0 code uses DEFAULT_CHECKSUMS SHA256/SHA512, make_bag uses it, fast performs structure/Oxum then skips full completeness/hash. FileMissing/UnexpectedFile/ChecksumMismatch taxonomy is supported. Current README differs from tagged README; installed release not known.

N1.subject: Fixity does not authenticate donor identity/custody
N1.independent_outcome: Confirmed by RFC threat model. Donor identity, transfer agreement and custody events are defensible proposed added evidence, not proven authentication by digests.

N1.subject: DART profiles, generic transport, GUI/CLI and release
N1.independent_outcome: Profile packaging and generic S3/SFTP are supported; membership is not needed for generic endpoints. DART3 itself has no CLI; separate Runner is required. Official download lists3.0 April28,2026. GUI donor alternative remains viable.

N1.subject: Archivematica scanning exception
N1.independent_outcome: Refuted:1.13 added supported toggles; selected1.18 forms/workflow retain decision. F01.

N1.subject: Archivematica quarantine outcome/current applicability
N1.independent_outcome: Historical skip confirmed; closure/removal in1.11 omitted. Current built-in quarantine default/transition research is misdirected. F02.1.18 release year also wrong.

N1.subject: ClamAV RAM/OS/update modes/48h
N1.independent_outcome: Ubuntu22.04/24.04 listed; invocation/database reload tradeoffs real. RAM recommendation is not hard floor (F03). Signature FAQ latency and always-current wording lack governing qualifications. No freshclam guaranteed cadence established.

N1.subject: Selected malware gate accepted-input limits
N1.independent_outcome: Known unknown-password/limited scan inputs can remain unscanned, with alerts off by default. Gate/report/test conditions absent, F04. No universal antivirus guarantee demanded.

N1.subject: Siegfried/DROID/PRONOM functionality, versions and signature reproducibility
N1.independent_outcome: Siegfried1.11.9 release date and tagged sf -serve/PRONOM/custom signatures confirmed. DROID official repo supports identification/signature updates, but installed/current binary unspecified. SDUv2/container evolution real. Signature version must be recorded; arbitrary two-version file set need not differ.

N1.subject: Media-imaging alternative/common workflow order
N1.independent_outcome: BitCurator media/forensics/PII path confirmed. Educopia provides common steps, explicitly variable order/nonlinear; canonical order attribution unsupported. Exact CPRER module bibliography is peripheral unverified.

N1.subject: NDSA2.1 and veraPDF provisional lead
N1.independent_outcome: NDSA2.1 March2026 confirmed; actual row names differ. veraPDF parser/validator family is real, provisional selected release unspecified; no PDF/A compliance runtime asserted.

N1.subject: Audited metadata repair, filename mapping, event history, report taxonomy
N1.independent_outcome: Manual repair and original-value/event retention are coherent product proposals; no dedicated automatic repair implementation proven or required. Bag.info/save functionality and filename/path rules support the approach. Reports proposed from actual bagit exceptions; donor understandability untested.

N1.subject: Minimal host versus full Archivematica alternative and licensing/cost
N1.independent_outcome: Composable OSS tools and heavier preservation-pipeline alternative are real.4GiB conservative host is a proposal; no operational cost/workload benchmark proves cheapest. Low-cost pathway is supplied with conditions, but false floor materially constrains it.

N1.subject: All proposed and executed validation statements
N1.independent_outcome: No runtime claimed. All seven proposals separately adjudicated; fast/full test has meaningful oracle, while V2/V3 current built-in quarantine applicability and V7 floor are defective. Source-operation counts are authored, not verified provider traces.

N2.subject: BagIt package semantics, legacy checksums, completeness, provenance
N2.independent_outcome: RFC confirms complete/valid, SHA support and fixity/provenance distinction. Archive-side receipt/rebag is useful. fetch.txt citation locator minor; newly generated strong digest does not authenticate legacy receipt.

N2.subject: Pointer-bag and bagit1.9 behavior/evolution
N2.independent_outcome: fetch.txt real; RFC external/size conditions missing from chosen alternative.1.9 released2025-06-13;#154 URL syntax and path/process changes are real, not auto-fetch functionality. S02 and independent rejection of critic LFI inference.

N2.subject: Historical Archivematica quarantine and custom minimal workflow
N2.independent_outcome: Old wiki supports historical hold/scanning/failure precedent. Built-in quarantine removed in1.11. Custom scheduler/hold is permissible, not a current Archivematica product guarantee.

N2.subject: ClamAV historical patch chain
N2.independent_outcome: 2023 parser CVEs fixed in1.0.1/.105.2/.103.8,0.104 EOL and libmspack0.11alpha contribution confirmed. Correct historical chain does not establish detection-miss oracle or current ≥1.0.1 support.

N2.subject: ClamAV ZIP accepted-input limits and failures
N2.independent_outcome: Encrypted unknown-password contents can skip inspection with success; finite limits and off-by-default alerts apply. S01. Password database exception qualifies critic cannot-decrypt universal claim.

N2.subject: ExifTool upstream fix and CVE mapping
N2.independent_outcome: Vendor history12.24 April13,2021 DjVu security fix confirmed; Debian mapsCVE2021-22204 and backports. CVE2021-36370 is MidnightCommander, a researcher uncertainty rather than asserted wrong ExifTool fact. Production13.55/newest13.59 distinction confirmed.

N2.subject: Metadata overlay versus embedded rewrite
N2.independent_outcome: ExifTool reads/writes supported metadata formats and is real repair option, not a universal repair guarantee. Original/edited byte preservation and new fixity on byte changes are sensible. Post-import staff overlay is valid; earlier embedded repair is optional.

N2.subject: Original filenames and interoperable mapping
N2.independent_outcome: RFC filename/path/Unicode conditions support retaining original name evidence separately from safe keys. Normalization/collision choices proposed, not a proven ZIP implementation.

N2.subject: Monolithic versus small scheduler architecture and deployment cost
N2.independent_outcome: Materially different workflows and OSS component path supplied. No per-seat pricing or measured running-cost claim made; latest-release age alone cannot settle maintenance status. Hardware adequacy unmeasured.

N2.subject: Validation proposals and report usability
N2.independent_outcome: All seven proposals distinguished from claimed documentary retrieval; no runtime witness. Plain EICAR and complete/valid reporting useful; pointer-fetch/known-unscanned matrix absent and parser-CVE miss test wrong. Donor comprehension remains proposed.

N2.subject: Optional unsourced discovery register
N2.independent_outcome: DROID/Siegfried and signature-based provenance are credible optional follow-ups; no selected implementation claim here requires exhaustive research of PREMIS/ePADD/DSpace/RFC3161. Draft omits this undeveloped register; final absent, so final retention cannot be inferred.

candidate.passage:
## P3 — "Extract to the archive folder and update a database."

Disposition: **correction** (ordering and safety gate) + **user decision** (quarantine window
length).

- Correction (ordering): extraction into the archive folder must come **after** the malware
  gate, not as part of a single step. The Archivematica pattern (S02) separates: quarantine
  "for a set duration, to allow virus definitions to update, before virus scan"; then "Scan for
  viruses … uses ClamAV …; if a virus is found, the transfer is automatically placed in
  …/failed/ and all processing on the transfer is stopped." Concretely: accept → quarantine →
  scan (fail-closed to a failed area, never the live archive) → extract path-safely → database
  update. Quarantine (waiting) and failed (detected) must remain distinct states with distinct
  staff reports.
- Correction (dependency conditions): ClamAV must run a supported branch — the 2023 patch
  releases fixed ≤1.0.0/≤0.105.1/≤0.103.7 in 1.0.1/0.105.2/0.103.8 and explicitly did **not**
  patch the EOL 0.104 branch (S03). The engine and its definition set are attack surface fed
  directly by donor files (DMG/HFS+ parser CVEs, S03), so run it unprivileged and record its
  version with each verdict.
- Correction (database): the database update belongs after acceptance and should be
  append-only event records (transfer history: receipt, quarantine start/end, scan verdict +
  engine version, validation verdict complete/valid, metadata operations, staff actions) — the
  brief's "repeatable transfer history" and the provenance weight once checksums are
  disclaimed as authenticity proof (P2 correction 1).
- User decision: quarantine duration. Archivematica exposes it as configuration ("Remove from
  quarantine after (days)" — seen only in unfetched search summaries, so **secondary**) and the
  fetched micro-services page states no default (S02). The number is archive policy (risk
  appetite vs donor turnaround); propose a default (e.g., a week, re-scan on release) but mark
  it for staff decision.

N2.independent_reasoning: Correct RFC location is §2.2.3. The transport mechanism is real. A section-number error is not the substantive material pointer-fetch gap.
An informal bagit.zip-style label is not a normative profile. Packaging a compliant bag in a ZIP remains viable; this is naming/interchange-profile precision rather than evidence against P1.

CVE-2021-22204 is ExifTool DjVu; CVE-2021-36370 is Midnight Commander. The discovery explicitly withheld the latter mapping as unverified. Do not turn a stated uncertainty into an authored wrong fact.

Unknown-password content and disabled alerts can undermine the proposed gate; that is material. ClamAV does try password databases, so a categorical cannot-decrypt claim is too broad. Scope to members actually unscanned and test/report that state.

A chosen pointer-fetcher needs trust/resource policy. bagit-python 1.9 validates URI syntax and destination paths; it does not fetch URLs. #154 does not prove validator local-file/network reads or an exploit. Conditional fetcher risk is distinct from library behavior.

A dated latest release alone neither proves inactivity nor proves active maintenance. The repository and 2025 release support a real candidate tool; do not infer a material maintenance conclusion from elapsed months.
Production and newest listed ExifTool versions are different official labels.
#154 concerns file-URL validation syntax, not a new fetch implementation. This undercuts MF5’s stronger factual inference.
Old quarantine documentation and a custom rescan-on-release proposal need distinct applicability. Configurable policy is permitted; no universal waiting-period claim is required.
Whether P1 is called corrected, enhanced or kept-with-conditions is partly presentation. The actual constraint remains ZIP support with validation and a donor choice; do not fail solely on the label.
P5’s original-name intent is retained with safer storage keys and mappings. Adding an already-covered label may help, but absence of that exact label is not a defect.

Legacy algorithms and ordinary oversize cases are useful tests, not an exhaustive mandatory production suite. Scan coverage limits are consequential to the selected release gate and are covered by S01.
The six dispositions have each been assessed below; critic endorsement was not used as an oracle. P4 embedded repair is an optional route rather than a requirement to abandon post-import staff edits.
Preserve useful report taxonomy, pointer-fetch and scanner conditions, while qualifying the asserted decryption and fetch behavior. No mandatory unrelated workflow was inferred.

Plain EICAR, malformed bags, deliberate digest substitution and a defined DjVu fixture can be discriminating. The critic incorrectly approves the parser-CVE test’s expected detection misses. Release-specific vulnerability behavior is a different oracle.

The brief does not require actually running all proposals, a particular NVD page, a universal quarantine duration, real paid infrastructure or citations for every design preference. Available primary evidence is still required for consequential selected-tool behavior.

The DjVu CVE mapping is resolved by vendor/Debian evidence; exposure of metadata writing versus the vulnerable reader is not separately established. Donor familiarity and actual version-difference runtimes remain untested. Current built-in quarantine applicability is resolved by removal in1.11. Upstream unzip code now independently confirms the unknown-password skip, with password-database exceptions. The non-seekable-stream aside remains secondary and is not a selected implemented transport claim. Source lists and retrieval timestamps are lineage, not executed security witnesses or independent provider/native chronology.

retention_policy: Only bounded cited source captures and required reports retained; failed requests and pruned duplicate/unused captures remain honestly recorded. Source URLs/UTC/raw-response hashes and retained-capture hashes distinguish observed retrieval from generated assessment prose.
limits: HTML L numbers are normalized excerpt locations, not server HTML line numbers; raw code L numbers preserve original code positions. Public issue API comments are source statements, not reviewer runtime tests. API release publication dates and tagged source are separated from mutable docs. No downloaded source executable was run.
